profile.name: Jaryl Ong
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I take a grounded approach to both life and work, preferring quiet consistency and practical problem-solving over chasing trends. I enjoy the process of breaking down complex ideas, focusing on the details, and delivering reliable results without the fluff.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built an AI engine on Claude that wires platforms together on its own, so new projects get onboarded without a team hand-integrating everything first.
Co-built a reusable dynamic form module on SurveyJS. Other teams now ship form-heavy apps without writing the frontend from scratch each time.
Set up containerised CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker across several core platform modules, so releases go out without anyone babysitting them.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed a full-stack dashboard framework in Go and Svelte that gave internal teams one consistent way to build charts and UI widgets, instead of everyone rolling their own.

projects.name: Vault of Cards
projects.description: A marketplace for trading card collectors. You can browse and search listings, put up your own with photos, sign in with a verified email, and message buyers and sellers in real time. Next.js on the front, NestJS microservices on AWS behind it.
bullets: Built the Next.js frontend and wired up GitHub Actions so every push deploys itself — no downtime, no manual steps.
Set up the AWS infrastructure with containerised microservices, so it stays fast and stays up even when traffic spikes.

projects.name: Askbot
projects.description: I wanted to know what frameworks like LangChain actually do under the hood, so I rebuilt their core pieces myself — token streaming, conversation memory, prompt construction — straight on the OpenAI SDK. FastAPI on the backend, Next.js on the front.
